clips.prompt: Locked-off static camera, no zoom. Animate this exact yellow plush mascot actively searching. The hand holding the magnifying glass moves it in a slow arc out to the side and slightly up, sweeping the lens left-right BESIDE its head, as if scanning the room; the body leans and turns gently toward the lens, the pupils follow the lens, small head tilt, subtle weight shift on its feet. The lens always stays beside the face and never passes in front of the eyes or mouth. Eyes stay wide open the entire time, no blinking. The hand keeps a firm grip on the magnifier handle; the other hand keeps holding the notebook against its side. Smoothly return to the exact starting pose at the end for a seamless loop. Face shape stays identical: same eyes, same small smile. Exactly two arms and two feet. Background stays perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF. Character stays centered.

localCorrection.method: Blink repair only; no regeneration. Each blink span takes the eye shapes (convex hull of sclera + pupil) from the nearest open-eye frame, aligned to head motion by phase correlation.

spans.searching: 4-13, 88-97 eye patch; 53-60 eye patch outside the lens plus lens-interior transfer tracked by Hough circle

composition: Magenta chroma key with despill. Both actions share one scale; the character is horizontally centered on its feet at x=420 with the feet baseline at y=672.
processing: 840x720 RGBA PNG frames. VP9 WebM CRF24 with alpha, HEVC alpha MOV (VideoToolbox, alpha_quality 0.75, 2.5 Mbps), WebP posters quality 92 from frame 0.
